facts.title: loss of containment at P-8303 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control CONTINUOUS_ATMOSPHERIC_MONITORING: the continuous atmospheric monitoring during occupancy was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control GAS_TEST_BEFORE_AND_DURING_HOT_WORK: the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STANDBY_ATTENDANCE_AND_RESCUE: the standby attendance and non-entry rescue capability was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on P-8303 and PT-8303 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the atmospheric gas testing before and during hot work on P-8303 and PT-8303 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising and controlling entry, specifically classifying a space and issuing an entry permit. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 5 January 2023 an incident occurred on P-8303 and PT-8303 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
